angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 729,094 km at 152.33 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.5645 +/- 0.0141 mas (same row, RUWE 0.91): 152.33 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.048 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Rodriguez et al. 2021, the stellar radius of TOI-1478 b's parameter set from Rodriguez et al. 2021 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..194R/abstract): 729,094 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.947 +/- 0.059 solar masses from Rodriguez et al. 2021, the stellar mass of TOI-1478 b's parameter set from Rodriguez et al. 2021 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..194R/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5597 +/- 83 K from Rodriguez et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of TOI-1478 b's parameter set from Rodriguez et al. 2021 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..194R/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Rodriguez et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of TOI-1478 b's parameter set from Rodriguez et al. 2021 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..194R/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1478.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.374, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1478 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.078 dex, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1478 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.01278, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1478 (pscomppars): age 9.1 Gyr, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1478 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.24 km/s, from Rice et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....164..104R/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
